changelog: - **The run row no longer cuts the Replay label, and nothing in it moves when a run ends.** The main run button had one width for every language, so “Opnieuw afspelen” (Dutch), “Erneut abspielen” (German), “Yeniden oynat” (Turkish) and “إعادة التشغيل” (Arabic) ran past its edge at the end of a run, and a few other labels sat a pixel or two into its padding. The button is now as wide as the widest of Play, Pause and Replay in the language you read, and it keeps that width in all three states. The step readout had room for the English and the Korean text only: in ten languages the ended text was wider, so the end of a run pushed the controls after it along. It now keeps the room of its own ended text, up to a five-digit step, in each language, and the controls stay where they are. Position comes first, so the wider button and readout take their room from the state beside the step: in German, Spanish, Turkish and Vietnamese, in a 1280 px window with both side panels open, the steady-state note shows its short wording (“Stabil” for “Stabil — läuft weiter”) and a document’s phase names show as their small button. The tooltip, the button’s popover and what a screen reader hears keep the whole text. The Korean short wording is now “정상 상태” (it was “흐름 계속”), so that it names the state as the other languages’ short wordings do. English and Korean look exactly as before at 1280 px. In the narrowest layout, a 900 px window with the properties panel docked, eight languages have no room for all of it: no text is cut there, and the end of a run still moves the controls after the readout, by no more than before except in German (5 to 13 px, was 3 px).
